title: Fahrenheit 451
author: Ray Bradbury
summary: In a future where houses are fireproof and firemen burn books instead of putting out fires, Guy Montag starts to question his job after a chance meeting with a curious young neighbour.
readIf: you want a short, lyrical dystopia about books, screens and attention.
skipIf: you want a detailed, realistic future; it is more of a warning than a world.

pairings.reason: The bleaker, more thorough dystopia about control, language and truth.
Another classic about a society pacified by pleasure and distraction.
A modern, harsher dystopia about a regime that strips away rights.
